hoddesdon.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Broxbourne
s1loc: Hoddesdon anchors the live-events trade of Broxbourne. The Spotlight on the High Street is the borough's biggest entertainment venue, running theatre, comedy, dance, live music and cinema across its hall and stage, while Barclay Park, gifted to the town in the 1930s, hosts the open-air fairs, fitness sessions and community gatherings that fill the Hoddesdon calendar. Up the Lea Valley, Hertford and Cheshunt add their own halls and outdoor dates through the warmer months.

And the trade runs at every size here. The Spotlight, festival operators and the production companies servicing Lea Valley events run sizeable seasonal crews and order through procurement, while independent promoters, mobile DJs and small event crews across the Broxbourne towns want only a handful of branded pieces. A workwear supplier has to dress the busy summer festival and the one-person promoter alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

Reliable kit matters most when the weather turns. A Barclay Park fair or a Lea-side outdoor date can swing from sun to downpour in an afternoon, so stewards, riggers and front-of-house staff need waterproofs that hold up, hi-vis that reads at distance and fleeces for the late get-out.
